Suporte do Shiba

Need help with Shiba? Email us and we will review your request.

Support URL: https://shibamuscle.com/contact.html

Contact support

For app issues, purchase questions, privacy requests, or feedback, contact:

Email: info@shibamuscle.com

What to include

  • Your device model and iOS version.
  • The Shiba app version, if available.
  • What happened and the steps that led to the issue.
  • Screenshots, if helpful. Please do not send passwords or full payment details.

Response and privacy

We review support requests in order. Response times may vary depending on the request.

Information you send is used to respond to and manage your support request.

Privacy Policy: Read the Shiba Privacy Policy
